ai_review.summary: Excellent recording of a rare electric Deep Elem performance
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes this tape as sounding “so dang good,” noting it’s a beloved favorite they’ve heard countless times. The performance is highlighted for the rare electric version of “Deep Elem,” and while they wish there were a second set, the available material is praised as flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review lauds both the musical performance and the audio fidelity, indicating an exceptional show and excellent recording despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer emphasizes the sound is “so dang good,” with no complaints about clarity or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a single song is highlighted; reviewer wishes for a second set but praises the existing material.
